purpose: The pre-flight release-plan-simulation step in .github/actions/callisto-validate/action.yml discards its command's exit code with `|| true`, and callisto-ci.yml's test job (`just test-ci`, justfile:46-48) runs cargo nextest and cargo test --doc only with --all-features (only the durable-release e2e suite also runs on default features, via `just release-workflow-behavior`), so a bug reachable only in the shipped default-feature ("cargo","npm") binary is never caught by CI. This spec makes the pre-flight step fail the job on error and adds default-feature test coverage to CI.
scope: .github/actions/callisto-validate/action.yml's Pre-Flight Release Plan Simulation step; callisto-ci.yml's test job and/or a new CI step running the callisto-cli test suite (or at minimum the durable-release e2e suite) with only default cargo features.
non_goals: Changing which command the pre-flight step runs (plan-publish today; SPEC-DX-RELEASE-CLI may rename this to `release --dry-run`) -- this spec only fixes the exit-code handling of whatever command that step runs.
release/derive.rs plan-derivation parity items and CI coverage of those specific behaviors (SPEC-DX-CORRECTNESS-PARITY).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The Pre-Flight Release Plan Simulation step in .github/actions/callisto-validate/action.yml fails the job (non-zero exit propagates) when the plan command it runs exits non-zero, instead of the current `callisto plan-publish --format text || true` which always exits 0.

[SUPERSEDED 2026-09-24: cargo features removed; tests and the shipped binary build one feature set] CI runs the full callisto-cli test suite compiled with default features only (no --all-features, no --features inference), as a required check separate from `just test-ci`. Today only `just release-workflow-behavior` (durable_release_e2e_tests) runs default features; every other callisto-cli test binary runs only under --all-features.

reasoning: Grounded against origin/fix/release-run-simplify@9be31095: .github/actions/callisto-validate/action.yml:24 confirmed to run `callisto plan-publish --format text || true`. callisto-ci.yml's test job (line 108) runs `just test-ci`, and justfile:46-48 confirms test-ci is `cargo nextest run --workspace --all-features --profile ci` plus `cargo test --doc --all-features` -- no default-feature invocation exists anywhere in CI, confirming the gap AC-19 requires closed.
